newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cosmetics distributor Sa Sa seen in HK$700 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Cosmetics distributor Sa Sa seen in HK$700 mln IPO.

text.p: Cosmetics products wholesaler and retailer Sa Sa International Holdings Ltd is expected to raise about HK$700 million in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong next week, market sources said.
Sources said the company is expected to issue about 328 million shares at price of from HK$2 to HK$2.38 per share, of which majority of the issue would place internationally.
Proceeds from the issue are expected to be used to fund expansion of its distribution network, sources said.
Credit Lyonnais is the global coordinator and sponsor of the issue, but no further listing details were immediately available, they said.
Sa Sa is expected to hold a press briefing revealing its listing plan on Monday before a presentation for analysts on Tuesday, sources said.

The company engages in the retail and wholesale of a wide range of cosmetic products including skin-care, make-up, fragrances and hair care products. It operates a chain of 11 retail outlets in Hong Kong and one in Taipei in Taiwan.
